content: Good night at The Off Broadway Lounge for the Gridiron Challenge. Had a bunch of people participate in Football Bingo. The first half of the game was somewhat fun and exciting with plenty going on throughout, so much so that I had 6 people get bingos, 2 of whom had multiple bingos. Congratulations to Shawn for winning that. hope to see everybody back next week.

content: Great night at The Rusty Bucket in Lakewood for some JAMMIN’ Trivia! Plenty of people showed up to play, started, peaked and finished with 6 rather large teams! My favorite thing about this location is how the teams all like to tease each other throughout the night and last night there was no shortage of that. There was plenty of back and forth in the scores as well as the teams hopped all over the board but in the end team Swamp Donkeys managed to win by just 1 point! Very close night! Thank you everyone for coming out and making it such a great night, hope to see everyone back next week!
